alert.name: nightly-digest errors
alert.summary: Errors >= 1 in 1 of 1 periods for nightly-digest

logs: ALARM AWS/Lambda/Errors FunctionName=nightly-digest stat=Sum period=300s threshold GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold 1.0 datapoints=1/1 missing=breaching state=ALARM
CHANGE none on nightly-digest in the 6 h before the alert
CONFIG lambda nightly-digest timeout=900s memory=512MB reserved_concurrency=none env=[DIGEST_TABLE=digests-dev] version=7 alias_live=7
